description:
- GBP is the site's default currency; EUR is the only other option in the
    header currency picker.
  - PLP (category grid) pages currently show no price at all on this site
    (name/image/variant-count only), so PLP is intentionally out of scope
    here - only PDP and the basket, where price is actually shown.

elements.name: Currency toggle is visible on the site

steps.name: I am on the "home" page
I dismiss the newsletter popup if present
the "currency picker" should be displayed

elements.name: Switching currency updates the PDP price and reverts back

steps.name: I am on the "solas" page
I dismiss the newsletter popup if present
the "product price" should contain the text "£"
I switch the currency to "EUR"
the "product price" should contain the text "€"
I switch the currency to "GBP"
the "product price" should contain the text "£"

elements.name: Switching currency updates the basket price and total, and reverts back

steps.name: I am navigating the page as a "logged in" user
I dismiss the newsletter popup if present
I am on the "place-order" page
I fill in the "Search products" input field with "Vanquish"
I wait for the search results to update
I click on the "first search result" element
I slowly click on the "first variant" element
